get.description: Retrieves a list of assets based on the provided query parameters. Pagination is handled by a cursor, which is provided in the HTTP response header for fetching subsequent results.
get.summary: Get a paginated list of assets

parameters.description: Maximum number of assets to return in a single response.
parameters.name: max

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination, obtained from a previous response to fetch the next set of assets.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Filter assets by their last active time, specified as a duration (e.g., "30d" for 30 days ago).
parameters.name: lastActiveTime

parameters.description: Filter assets by their first active time, specified as a duration (e.g., "30d" for 30 days ago).
parameters.name: firstActiveTime

parameters.description: Filter assets based on their vulnerability status (true for vulnerable, false for not vulnerable).
parameters.name: vulnerable

parameters.description: Filter assets that have active alerts (true) or do not (false).
parameters.name: hasActiveAlerts

parameters.description: Filter assets by functional group name.
parameters.name: functionalGroupName

parameters.description: Filter assets by vendor name.
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.description: Filter assets by type.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Filter assets by their name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Maximum number of assets to return in a single response.

parameters.description: Filter alerts by specific asset name.

get.description: Retrieves a list of assets that are affected by the specified vulnerability ID. Accepts either a public CVE identifier (CVE-YYYY-NNNNN, e.g. "CVE-2021-34527") or a Cisco-private vulnerability identifier (PVT-YYYY-NNNNN, e.g. "PVT-2025-00001"). Each asset includes its name, network interfaces (IP, MAC), and type. Pagination is handled by a cursor, which is provided in the HTTP response header for fetching subsequent results.
get.summary: Get list of assets by vulnerability ID

parameters.description: Any vulnerability identifier — CVE-YYYY-NNNNN or PVT-YYYY-NNNNN. The legacy parameter name (cveId) is preserved for backward compatibility.
parameters.name: cveId

parameters.name: max

parameters.name: cursor

parameters.name: type

get.description: Retrieves organization hierarchy levels as a flat array with cursor-based pagination using pathId.
get.summary: Get the global organization hierarchy with pagination

parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (default 10, max 500)
parameters.name: max

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination, obtained from a previous response to fetch the next set of levels.
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Creates one or more organization hierarchy levels. Supports partial success when creating multiple levels.

parameters.description: One or more hierarchy levels to create
parameters.name: body

201.description: Levels created (check successCount and failedCount for details)

delete.description: Deletes an existing level from the organization hierarchy. System-defined levels (Global) cannot be deleted. The level must not have any sub levels or members attached.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the level to delete
parameters.name: levelId

patch.description: Updates the name of an existing level in the organization hierarchy. The hierarchy path will be automatically updated for the level and all its descendants. System-defined levels (Global, Public, Unused) cannot be renamed.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the level to rename
parameters.name: levelId

parameters.description: New name for the hierarchy level
parameters.name: body

put.description: Assigns one or more networks to a specified hierarchy level. Networks are identified by their UUIDs and the target level is specified by its UUID in the path. The endpoint validates that both the level and all network IDs exist before performing any assignments. If validation fails, no changes are made. Maximum 500 networks can be assigned in a single request.
put.summary: Assign networks to a hierarchy level

parameters.description: UUID of the hierarchy level to assign networks to
parameters.name: levelId

parameters.description: Request payload containing list of network UUIDs
parameters.name: body

204.description: All networks successfully assigned - empty response body

AssetVulnerabilityBulkAckRequestPayload.description:
Contains vulnerability IDs (CVE-* or PVT-*) and a mandatory acknowledgment comment.
The legacy field name `cveIds` is preserved for backward compatibility.
AssetVulnerabilityBulkAckRequestPayload.title: AssetVulnerabilityBulkAckRequestPayload represents bulk ack payload for one asset.

cveIds.description:
List of vulnerability identifiers to acknowledge for the asset.
Accepts both CVE-YYYY-NNNNN (public KDB feed) and PVT-YYYY-NNNNN
(Cisco-private KDB feed) ids; the field name is unchanged.

AssetVulnerabilityBulkUnackRequestPayloa.description:
Contains vulnerability IDs (CVE-* or PVT-*) to remove acknowledgment from.
The legacy field name `cveIds` is preserved for backward compatibility.
AssetVulnerabilityBulkUnackRequestPayloa.title: AssetVulnerabilityBulkUnackRequestPayload represents bulk unack payload for one asset.

cveIds.description:
List of vulnerability identifiers to unacknowledge for the asset.
Accepts both CVE-YYYY-NNNNN and PVT-YYYY-NNNNN ids.

NetworkAssignRequest.description: NetworkAssignRequest represents the request body for assigning networks to a hierarchy level

networks.description: List of network UUIDs to assign

cveId.description:
CveID identifies the vulnerability. May carry a CVE-* identifier
(public KDB feed, NVD-aggregated) or a PVT-* identifier
(Cisco-private KDB feed). The field name is preserved for
backward compatibility; do not rename.

source.description:
Source is the KDB feed of origin: "public" (CVE-*) or "private" (PVT-*).
Clients may use this in addition to / instead of inspecting the prefix.
